csv_project_name: CM & Inspection Service for Various Capital Projects
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Wenatchee invites qualified Construction Management and Inspection firms to submit a Statement of Qualifications for an on-call Construction Management and Inspection contract. The selected firm will provide general on-call Construction Management and Inspection services including but not limited to: general daily inspection of construction progress and compliance with permits and approved plans, materials documentation and acceptance, in-office contract administration related to weekly statements of working days, materials submittals, traffic control plan review, stakeholder coordination, receipt and response to RFIs; and other related professional services.
